question: Is datasets for sentiment analysis balanced?

evidence: In the sentiment analysis experiments, we found that a tweet may contain multiple sentiments. The groundtruth labels contain 210 positive sentiments, 521 neutral sentiments, and 305 negative sentiments to the candidates. We measured the CCR, across all tweets, to be 31.7% for Rosette Text Analytics, 43.2% for Google Cloud, 44.2% for TensiStrength, and 74.7% for the crowdworkers. This means the difference between the performance of the tools and the crowdworkers is significant – more than 30 percent points.

title: Performance Comparison of Crowdworkers and NLP Tools onNamed-Entity Recognition and Sentiment Analysis of Political Tweets
answer_rationale: The document states that the dataset used for sentiment analysis contains an imbalance in sentiment labels: 210 positive, 521 neutral, and 305 negative sentiments. The authors also mention in their future work that they plan to use a balanced dataset for training, implying the current one is not balanced.
